title: Wuwen Xinqiong Partners with MiniMax: From Inference Efficiency to Token Services, Domestic Large Models Join Forces to Build an Ecosystem

content_html:
Shanghai Wuwen Xinqiong Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and Shanghai Xiyu Technology (MiniMax) have recently signed a strategic cooperation agreement. Both AI companies based in Shanghai have expanded their collaboration in four directions: co-optimizing the model inference efficiency system, jointly building large model Token services and AI infrastructure, joint innovation in application paradigms, and large-scale expansion of intelligent scenarios in industries.

Translate this cooperation framework: Wuwen Xinqiong excels in computing power scheduling and inference infrastructure, while MiniMax holds self-developed large models and massive application traffic. The former helps the latter run models more efficiently and cost-effectively, while the latter provides the former with real business scenarios and large volumes of Token consumption. The two companies are integrating from the bottom layer of inference efficiency, to the middle layer of Token services and infrastructure, and up to the upper layer of industry scenarios, effectively linking two key players in the "training-inference-deployment" chain of domestic large models. In the current context where both computing costs and application deployment face pressure, such upstream and downstream collaboration has become an increasingly common survival strategy within the domestic large model ecosystem.

content_html_zh:
上海无文新琼智能科技有限公司与上海熙宇科技（MiniMax）近日签署战略合作协议。 两家总部位于上海的AI公司在四个方向上拓展了合作：共同优化模型推理效率体系、共同构建大型模型Token服务和AI基础设施、联合创新应用范式、大规模拓展行业智能场景。

翻译一下这个合作框架：无文新琼擅长算力调度和推理基础设施，而MiniMax则掌握着自研的大型模型和海量应用流量。 前者帮助后者更高效、更经济地运行模型，后者为前者提供真实的业务场景和大量的Token消耗。 两家公司正在从底层的推理效率，到中间的Token服务和基础设施，再到上层的行业场景进行整合，有效链接国内大模型“训练-推理-部署”链条上的两个关键参与者。 在当前计算成本和应用部署都面临压力的背景下，这种上下游协作已经成为国内大模型生态中越来越普遍的生存策略。
